supported: Clang preprocessing, macros, includes and original-source line mapping
ref class declarations, abstract and sealed class flags
static managed methods and ordinary global functions
String handles, literal allocation and UTF-16 string emission
Clang overload resolution after contextual managed literal adaptation
initialized locals, parameters, arithmetic, comparisons and native XOR
if/else, while, for, break, continue and returns
source-built ilasm assembly and source-built CoreCLR execution
limitations: Only directly imported qualified static calls receive contextual literal adaptation
Metadata headers are generated for explicitly selected types
No instance members, fields, inheritance or user constructors yet
No CLI generics, managed arrays, properties, delegates, events or exception regions yet
No native/managed interop or mixed-mode PE output yet
Unsupported AST nodes are errors; this is not a conforming general C++/CLI compiler
